CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_stock_movement_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_product_name text;
  v_sku text;
  v_unit text;
  v_category text;
  v_title text;
  v_event_type text;
  v_qty numeric;
  v_event_id uuid;
begin
  v_qty := abs(coalesce(new.amount, 0));

  if v_qty <= 0 or new.product_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  -- Business-event identity:
  -- inbound batch/partial receive -> shared event_id
  -- ordinary movement          -> movement id
  v_event_id := coalesce(new.event_id, new.id);

  select
    p.name,
    p.sku,
    p.unit,
    p.category
  into
    v_product_name,
    v_sku,
    v_unit,
    v_category
  from public.products p
  where p.id = new.product_id
    and p.organization_id = new.organization_id
  limit 1;

  if upper(coalesce(new.mode, '')) in (
    'ADD',
    'IN',
    'STOCK_IN',
    'RECEIVE',
    'RECEIVED',
    'PURCHASE',
    'INBOUND'
  ) then
    v_title := 'New Stock Received';
    v_event_type := 'STOCK_IN';
  else
    v_title := 'Stock Reduced';
    v_event_type := 'STOCK_OUT';
  end if;

  -- Idempotency remains movement-level.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.notifications n
    where n.ref_movement_id = new.id
    limit 1
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.notifications (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    source_store_id,
    event_type,
    title,
    body,
    items,
    total_units,
    total_skus,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_name,
    ref_movement_id,
    created_by,
    created_at,
    event_id
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.store_id,
    null,
    v_event_type,
    v_title,

    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'stock_movements',
      'mode', new.mode,
      'note', new.note,
      'movement_id', new.id,
      'event_id', v_event_id,
      'product_id', new.product_id,
      'product_name',
        coalesce(
          nullif(v_product_name, ''),
          'Unknown Product'
        )
    ),

    jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id', new.product_id,
        'product_name',
          coalesce(
            nullif(v_product_name, ''),
            'Unknown Product'
          ),
        'name',
          coalesce(
            nullif(v_product_name, ''),
            'Unknown Product'
          ),
        'sku', v_sku,
        'unit', v_unit,
        'category', v_category,
        'qty', v_qty
      )
    ),

    v_qty,
    1,
    coalesce(new.created_by, auth.uid()),
    null,
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.created_by, auth.uid()),
    coalesce(new.created_at, now()),
    v_event_id
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$
